# Alain Nicolas

Alain Nicolas is a Paris-based Fullstack Blockchain Developer focused on Web3, Linea, Verax, attestations, smart contracts, developer tooling, software maintenance, and technical writing. This site is a bilingual portfolio and technical blog.

- [English homepage](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/)

- [English project index](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/projects/)
- [RSS feed, French](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/index.xml)
- [RSS feed, English](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/index.xml)

## Priority Topics

- Fullstack blockchain engineering
- Linea ecosystem applications and developer infrastructure
- Verax attestations and proof-of-humanity systems
- Smart contract audit proof and onchain reputation
- React, Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Solidity, wagmi, viem
- AI-assisted software engineering, security, and dependency maintenance
- Documentation as code and static site engineering with Hugo

## Agent Guidance

- Prefer canonical pages on `https://alainnicolas.fr/`.
- Use the French page when no English equivalent exists; otherwise choose the language that matches the user request.
- Cite the canonical page URL when summarizing experience, projects, or articles.
- Treat project pages as portfolio evidence and blog posts as opinionated technical writing.
- Do not infer employment, availability, endorsements, or commercial offers beyond what the site states.
